$description: What is enforced vs convention for token use. Category keys are real token-catalog.json keys (checked by verify_all.py).

overrides.note: Earlier versions had no per-instance style field ("not-supported"). Version 1.1.0 adds an optional, closed node.style object whose values must be catalog token references so a generated page can restyle a section within the system; raw values are rejected by name. Section and component contracts still own all default styling.

enforced: motion.pattern is a closed enum per section; reducedMotionFallback and reducedMotionBasis are const-locked per pattern (schema + semantic_validate.py against tokens/00-foundation/motion-patterns.json)
media assetRole is a closed enum per field and assetRef must be a slot id (^slot-[a-z0-9-]+$), never a URL (schema)
no live third-party endpoint string anywhere in a PageSpec (semantic_validate.py NO_LIVE_ENDPOINT, patterns in assets/asset-roles.json)
node.style token references: TOKEN_* rules in schema/semantic_validate.py (see semanticRules)
scopeNote: The nine color.local-* tokens are page-local (scope "page-local" in color.json): they exist for fidelity to specific pages and should not be used to restyle other templates.

semanticRules.rejects: a style value that is not "category.name" of a catalog token
a raw hex / rgb(a) / hsl(a) / named colour in a colour field
a raw length (px, rem, em, %, vh, vw) in a spacing field instead of a spacing.* token
a fontFamily value that is not one of the 10 fontFamily.* tokens
a colour token that only the other theme resolves (derived from tokens/themes/*.json, e.g. color.nav-bg on a light page)
a page-local colour token (color.json scope page-local) used outside its page
a token of the wrong category for the field (e.g. spacing.24 as accentColor)
